title: JSON Table value
description: The value of a field which uses the JSON Table interface of directus-extension-json-table (format version 1). See docs/format.md. The schema checks the structure. The interface also checks what a schema cannot: that every row has as many cells as there are columns (or one), that every name is in `shared`, that no shared cell leads back to itself, and that a part does not use a shared cell which has parts.

plainValue.title: A table which is stored as it is

compressedValue.title: A table which is stored compressed

data.description: The base64 of the gzip of the JSON of the table.

shared.description: Cells by name, which other cells start from with `use` or by being that name.

columns.description: The header row: one cell per table column.

rows.description: Each row has one cell per column, or a single cell, which makes it a heading.

legend.description: Cells drawn under the table, each followed by its `tip`.

cell.description: An object, or the name of a cell in `shared`.

use.description: The name of a cell in `shared` to start from.

text.description: The text, or a list of parts.

icon.description: The name of a Material Symbols icon, drawn in front of the text.

weight.description: The font weight. 400 is normal and 700 is bold.

tip.description: The tooltip, and the label of the cell in the legend.

break.description: On a part, true starts a new line with it. On a cell, it does so for every part.

part.description: Text, a number, or an object with the fields of a cell except `background`.

color.description: A hex colour (#RGB, #RGBA, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA) or a theme variable of the app, such as var(--theme--success).

link.description: An item which the text opens in a drawer.
